display.purpose: Hero headlines and any single number meant to dominate its block.

title.purpose: Card and module titles, and page headers.

body.purpose: Running copy in Ink Soft, roughly 65-75 characters per line.

label.purpose: Uppercase kickers and micro-labels in Ink Faint or Wheat Dark.

numeric.purpose: Every data figure, KPI delta and axis value; tabular lining figures.

shadows.name: edge-highlight
shadows.purpose: Hairline top light that opens every card and floating surface; 6% white in dark mode.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation of cards, dropdown panels and KPI tiles.

shadows.name: nav
shadows.purpose: Subtle underside of the scrolled sticky header.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Hero bands, modals, drawers and the phone mockup.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Floating chips and chart tooltips that must clear busy content.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Entrances and reveals; a monotonic ease-out, not a bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a screen: top-lit forest green, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 10px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-green) 86%, white 14%), var(--color-agro-green)); color: #fff; font: 600 0.875rem/1 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22), 0 1px 2px rgb(20 26 21 / 0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: background-image 200ms var(--ease-out-soft), transform 160ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-agro-green), var(--color-agro-green-dark)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-green) 70%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action: card background with a hairline border.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action in Deep Terracotta; reserved for real consequences.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-agro-earth-dark); color: #fff; font: 600 0.875rem/1 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(20 26 21 / 0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--color-agro-earth); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-earth) 70%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Card-backed field; the focus ring turns brand green.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font: 600 0.75rem/1 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-faint); } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-agro-border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-faint); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-agro-green); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-green) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Full-round tone pill with a leading dot; status never relies on colour alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-green) 10%, transparent); color: var(--color-agro-green-dark); font: 600 0.75rem/1 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-green) 15%, transparent); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-agro-green); }

components.css: .ds-hero-band { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 48px 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-card-lg); color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--color-agro-forest), var(--color-agro-green) 52%, var(--color-agro-olive)) padding-box, linear-gradient(140deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-olive) 85%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-agro-wheat) 70%, transparent)) border-box; box-shadow: var(--shadow-float), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); } .ds-hero-band::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(22rem 14rem at 90% -20%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22), transparent 60%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-hero-band > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: 0; } .ds-hero-kicker { font: 600 0.75rem/1 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); } .ds-hero-title { margin-top: 12px; font-family: var(--font-display), Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.06; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-hero-text { margin-top: 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); }

narrative.overview:
Agro Trazabilidad's visual system is the bridge the product itself is: the distance between the lot gate and the dashboard. The field is warm and physical — terracotta, wheat and ochre, the colours of turned soil and ripe grain — and the office is cool and exact: a near-black ink on off-white paper, mature forest green for action, slate for the machinery rail. Every screen is asked to read as the same instrument seen from both ends of the corridor, so the operator's phone in the sun and the owner's desktop in the office feel like one system, not two.

The character is grounded and editorial, not startup-generic. Fraunces, a high-contrast serif, is reserved for names and protagonist figures so a module title or a headline number carries the weight of a printed label; Inter carries the working UI and every figure that must line up in a column. Depth is real but restrained: surfaces are tinted with a whisper of the brand green and lifted by a 1px inset highlight over a two-layer ambient shadow, never a flat grey drop. A fine grain and soft radial glows sit under the whole canvas so the page reads as a surface with atmosphere rather than a flat rectangle.

Confirmed directional intent (not yet current state). The team has chosen a course toward more expressiveness: bolder display typography, richer surface gradients and more pronounced motion are the intended direction of travel. The system documented here is the incumbent state; treat the expressiveness push as a direction to grow toward, not a description of what ships today.
keyCharacteristics: Three colours do the work: mature forest green (identity and primary action), warm terracotta (data and secondary emphasis), and near-black ink on off-white paper (structure).
Two typefaces, two jobs: Fraunces for names and protagonist numerals, Inter (tabular) for everything functional.
Depth from light, not from grey: a 1px inset highlight, a two-layer ambient shadow and a green-tinted surface gradient.
Generous, soft geometry: nothing sharper than 0.5rem, most surfaces at 1-1.25rem, pills at full round.
Field texture at the edges: fine film grain, a SIG-style plot grid, notebook rules and terrain-gradient hero bands.

rules.name: The One Green, One Earth Rule
rules.body: Brand green carries identity and every primary action; terracotta is the only secondary accent and stays reserved for data and emphasis. No third brand hue is introduced — additional colour is a defect, not a feature.

rules.name: The Serif Protagonist Rule
rules.body: A name or number the user must read at a glance wears Fraunces; everything else is Inter, and every numeric value uses tabular figures. Mixing a non-tabular figure into a column is a layout bug.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is never a flat grey shadow. Every elevated surface pairs a 1px inset top highlight with a two-layer ambient shadow over a subtly green-tinted gradient — remove any one of the three and the surface goes slack.

dos: Do set headings, hero copy and protagonist numbers in Fraunces (font-display).
Do apply .text-numeric (tabular lining figures) to every data value, KPI and axis label.
Do use var(--color-agro-green) for the one primary action on a screen, and keep it rare.
Do build elevation as hairline inset + two-layer ambient shadow + green-tinted gradient (shadow-card at rest, shadow-card-hover on lift).
Do keep every corner soft — 0.5rem minimum, 1rem-1.25rem for surfaces, full-round for pills and progress.
Do drive colour from tokens so light and dark mode both resolve; verify text on the lighter end of any gradient.
donts: Don't introduce a third brand hue or a second primary accent — green leads, terracotta supports, and that's the whole palette.
Don't put terracotta (earth) on a primary call to action; primary actions are green.
Don't use flat grey drop shadows or a pure-black ink; depth comes from the hairline-plus-ambient pair and ink stays near-black (#151a20).
Don't hardcode hex values in components where a --color-* token exists — it breaks dark mode.
Don't set data figures in a non-tabular face or let columns of numbers go ragged.
Don't rename, reorder or strip the canonical design sections or the token layer; downstream tooling parses them literally.
